prompt: In a flat vector illustration, a serene mountain campsite unfolds under a clear sky. On the left, a tall pine tree with dark green needles stands firmly beside a large gray boulder. Next to the boulder sits a woman in a yellow raincoat, her legs crossed comfortably on the grass. A small blue tent is pitched in the center, its flap open to reveal a sleeping bag inside. Beside the tent entrance, a man in a red scarf holds a steaming mug, looking toward the fire. In front of him, a black cast-iron pot hangs over a crackling orange campfire, suspended by a metal tripod. To the right of the fire, a brown dog lies curled up, resting its head on its paws. Standing near the dog is a child in a striped shirt, pointing excitedly at the flames. Behind the child, a wooden picnic table holds a checkered blanket and a basket of apples. An older person with white hair sits on the bench of the table, handing an apple to the child. Above the scene, a crescent moon hangs in the deep blue sky, while distant purple mountains form the backdrop. There is no smoke rising from the fire, and there is no water source visible in the foreground. The woman in the yellow raincoat looks at the man in the red scarf, who smiles back while holding his mug. The brown dog is positioned next to the child in the striped shirt, creating a sense of companionship. The tall pine tree is located on the far left, framing the composition, while the wooden picnic table occupies the right side. The black cast-iron pot is directly above the orange campfire, emphasizing the cooking activity. The large gray boulder provides a natural seat for the woman in the yellow raincoat, grounding her presence in the scene.
